欧文的生活方式(Owen's Way of Living): 一篇关于城市生活的B1记叙文:欧文的经历、感受与成长。

The pedestrian street looked quieter than usual that evening. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. Owen prefers snowy weather when running in the library. Best of all, littering in the park is a shameful habit.

Leo always says that small steps matter more than big plans. The experience taught Owen more than any book could. People around Owen often share different ideas about the pedestrian street. The carpenter fitted new shelves in the living room.

Owen believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. Meeting the famous writer was a real privilege.
Owen bought a sweater online because it was much cheaper. Leo advised Owen to try dancing as a new hobby. On Wednesday evenings, Owen reviews the notes from class. Size eight is out of stock.
There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. There are always more possibilities than we expect. Little by little, things began to change.
